description: List the calendars declared in the manifest (names, timeZone, provider binding, declared event counts, recorded state counts). Desired state lives in YAML — to change events, edit the calendar files then call cicada.plan.preview / cicada.plan.apply. There is no events.create (ADR-0002 §10).
name: cicada.calendar.list

description: Expand declared (or live, with `live: true`) events into concrete occurrences inside [from, to). Read-only.

calendar.description: Limit to one declared calendar name; default all.

from.description: Window start: `today`, `+Nd`, `+Nw`, a date (2026-08-19), a civil datetime, or an RFC 3339 instant. Resolved in each calendar's timeZone.

live.description: Expand the provider's live events instead of the desired YAML. Default false.

name: cicada.events.range

description: Show one declared event by stable local id: its fields plus occurrences inside a window. Read-only.

from.description: Window start: `today`, `+Nd`, `+Nw`, a date (2026-08-19), a civil datetime, or an RFC 3339 instant. Resolved in each calendar's timeZone.

name: cicada.events.show

description: Compare recorded state against live provider state — reports managed events that are missing or modified remotely (ADR-0002 §4). Read-only.
name: cicada.state.drift

description: Pull live provider state into recorded state for every managed calendar — reconciles recorded state after out-of-band edits so the next plan sees live truth. Writes only the local state file (under its advisory lock); no remote mutations.
name: cicada.state.refresh

description: Dry-run: diff declared YAML vs recorded vs live into a `cicada/plan-v1` document per calendar. Returns a `planDigest` identifying this preview — pass it to cicada.plan.apply to execute. Always safe; never mutates anything.

notify.description: Attendee-notification policy override (ADR-0002 §5); default each calendar's spec.apply.sendUpdates.

name: cicada.plan.preview

description: Execute a previewed plan against the provider — GATED: requires `confirm: true` AND a `planDigest` returned by cicada.plan.preview in this session. The server re-plans before applying; a digest that no longer matches (YAML/live/recorded changed since preview) is rejected as stale. Runs under the state file lock; mutating ops are never implicit (ADR-0001 §8a).

confirm.description: Must be true — explicit user approval to mutate.

force.description: Overwrite out-of-band edits instead of failing on drift conflict (ADR-0002 §4).

notify.description: Attendee-notification policy override (ADR-0002 §5); must match the preview's choice or the digest goes stale.

planDigest.description: Digest from cicada.plan.preview in this session.

resume.description: Skip ops already journaled as applied (crash resume, ADR-0001 §4).

name: cicada.plan.apply
